export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}

      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)

    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }

  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {

    if ovr >= 86:

    return max(ovr, min(95, round(ovr + growth)))

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable soccer manager game with real clubs/players from the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga and Ligue 1, including youth academy, player potential, hireable coaches, transfer funds/player purchases.

## Requirements
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Real-world clubs and players.
- Playable game, not a mockup.
- Must support desktop and mobile.

## Decisions
- Built as a static vanilla-JS SPA served by `index.html` (matches existing runtime expectations).
- Data sourced from EA SPORTS FC 25 fan dataset `male_players.csv`; generated 96 clubs, 2,612 real players, all five leagues.
- Added derived potential, values, wages, club budgets, reputation, stadiums and colors.
- Added fictional generated youth prospects; real player/coach names otherwise.
- Fixed 96-club universe; no promotion/relegation between leagues.
- Visual club crests are stylized monogram badges (no downloaded logos).
- Game named “Touchline”; season starts 2024/25.

## Work State
### Completed
- Downloaded and parsed FC25 dataset to `/tmp/fc25.csv`.
- Generated `/js/data.js` (~0.83 MB) with `LEAGUES`, `CLUBS`, `PLAYERS`, `COACHES`.
- Implemented `/js/db.js`: mutable player DB, club/squad maps, transfer helpers.
- Implemented `/js/engine.js`: formations, position compatibility, lineups, team strength, match simulation, fixtures, tables, top scorers, economics, youth generation, development, flags.
- Implemented `/js/game.js`: save/load, new game, match completion, league-wide simulation, season end/rollover, transfers, sales, academy, staff, lineups, finances.
- Implemented `/index.html` and `/css/styles.css` with dark football-manager theme, responsive layouts, match overlay, cards, badges, tables, modals, mobile bottom nav.
- Implemented `/js/ui.js`: landing/onboarding, dashboard, squad, transfers, academy, staff, fixtures, leagues, finances, help, modals, live match UI, event handling.

### Active
- Debugging and wiring UI module; latest edit refactored `openBidModal` to accept message/preset values and store `UI.modal.playerId`.
- `app.js` entry file has not yet been created.
- No browser testing or screenshots yet.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Create `/js/app.js` importing `initUI` from `ui.js` and calling it.
2. Remove/replace the temporary function-reassignment wrapper at the bottom of `ui.js` (`const originalOpenBidModal = openBidModal; openBidModal = function...`) because `openBidModal` now stores `playerId` itself.
3. Fix `handleSubmit` bid branch: remove unused `const id`, read `UI.modal.playerId`, and on `counter`/`rejected` call `openBidModal(playerId, res.message, type, res.asking, res.demand)` instead of re-rendering stale body.
4. Fix `handleClick` so it does not `preventDefault()` on `SELECT`/`INPUT`/`TEXTAREA` elements.
5. Fix `recentResults()` result mapping: `gf > ga ? 'W' : gf < ga ? 'L' : 'D'`.
6. Combine the two `.match-side` panels into one, or adjust CSS so match grid shows only one side panel.
7. Fix CSS at `max-width: 1180px` for `.match-side` (currently grid-column full width while children hidden).
8. Test with `node` syntax checks, then run server and browser capture.
9. Check `start.sh`/runtime expectations and ensure app loads at `/`.
10. Add/update README with game instructions and data attribution if time permits.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: app entry shell.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/styles.css`: full responsive styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: generated club/league/player/coach dataset.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/db.js`: mutable database and squad maps.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/engine.js`: simulation, fixtures, ratings, youth, economics.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: game state, save/load, transfers, seasons, staff, academy.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui.js`: all UI rendering, modals, match overlay, event handling.
- `/tmp/gen_data.py`: data generator with club metadata/colors (regenerates `data.js`).
- `/tmp/fc25.csv`: FC25 source dataset, not committed.

## Important Context
- `data.js` is 96 clubs: PL 20, La Liga 20, Serie A 20, Bundesliga 18, Ligue 1 18.
- Save key is `touchline-save-v1`; base player overrides are stored as compact arrays.
- `game.js` exports live binding `state`; `ui.js` accesses `G.state`.
- `game.js` `loadGame()` was fixed to apply overrides to `DB.byId` clones, not base data.
- `makeOffer()` was fixed to capture `oldClub` before `movePlayer`.
- Potential game-breaking issue: `handleClick` currently calls `event.preventDefault()` for every `[data-action]`, including `<select>` filters/formation controls.
- `openBidModal` currently sets `UI.modal.playerId` after `openModal()`; bid submit relies on this.
- UI bid failure path currently only sets `UI.modal.message` and calls `renderModal()` with the old body, so the message may not show and counter values won’t populate.
- Match overlay renders two `.match-side` elements but CSS grid only has 3 columns; needs cleanup.
- The game has not yet been run in a browser; expect syntax/runtime debugging.
